messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Shifa ba kauye koyaje birni sai ya shekara 40 kafin ya waye, gidadawa KD sai a kara jiran lokaci 😂🤣😂😂

output.original_text: Shifa ba kauye koyaje birni sai ya shekara 40 kafin ya waye, gidadawa KD sai a kara jiran lokaci 😂🤣😂😂
output.joy: Na yi farin ciki da cewa inda ba dama kai kauye ba ne, sai shekara 40 a jiya, har yanzu a gidadawa KD za mu yi jira mai dadi! 😂🤣😂😂
output.sadness: Duk da cewa na san ina son kauye, sai na yi tunanin shekara 40 kafin wani ya daga kai, a gidadawa KD kuma sai mu yi jira dakuwa...
output.fear: Na tsorata da tunanin ba zan taba ganin birni ba har shekara 40, a gidadawa KD kuma zan zauna ina jiran mai yiwuwa ne!
output.anger: Wannan hali da aka ce sai shekara 40 kafin in ga birni, abun haushin gaske ne! A gidadawa KD kuma har yanzu sai a jira, wane irin rashin hankali ne!
output.surprise: Abin mamaki ne, wane lokaci na haka sai shekara 40 kafin a sa ka daga kauye zuwa birni! Yanzu gidadawa KD za mu jira ta ina!
output.disgust: Na ji zazzabi da jin wannan, har shekara 40 kafin ka iya zuwa birni? To, gidadawa KD shima yana da alajj, ya kamata mu daina wannan.
